title: trace-search License Manifest
description: Machine-readable license manifest for all dependencies, models, weights, datasets, and test clips. See PRD Cut 01 §2a and AC-01.

entries.description: List of all dependencies, models, weights, datasets, and clips

version.description: Version string or git commit hash

license.description: License identifier (SPDX preferred) or full license name

source_url.description: Source URL (repo, download page, or PyPI)

license_version.description: For clips only: license version or terms last-updated date

date_checked_ist.description: For clips only: date license terms were checked (IST, YYYY-MM-DD)

phash.description: For clips only: perceptual hashes of sampled frames (hex)

use.description: For clips only: usage tag (e.g., SMOKE_ONLY)

notes.description: Optional notes about provenance or special handling
